name: io.github.Avinash-jetwani/jevmem
title: jevmem
description: Automatic project memory for Claude Code. Also works with Cursor and Codex.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TypeSafe API key for Jev, which add_memory, search_memory and audit_memory use. If unset, the server reads it from <project>/.jevmem/.env or ~/.jevmem/env.

environmentVariables.name: JEVMEM_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Project root, for clients that start the server without a project working directory (Claude Desktop). One server entry serves one project.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Send Jev requests through a proxy or gateway instead of api.typesafe.ai.

environmentVariables.name: JEVMEM_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: 0 turns off the answer cache in .jevmem/.
